summary: The proposed patch changes the behavior of `Contains.as_set` to return the second argument instead of raising `NotImplementedError`. This may resolve the immediate issue but introduces potential regressions and lacks comprehensive testing.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of `Contains.as_set` to return the second argument instead of raising `NotImplementedError`. This may break existing code that relies on the exception being raised.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify the correctness of the change. There is a risk that the change may introduce new bugs or regressions.
The patch is minimal but may be difficult to understand for future maintainers. A comment explaining the rationale behind the change would improve readability.
